profile.ja: 石遁使いとして徐々に活躍をしている五車学園の対魔忍。誰にでも明るく気さくに声をかける、好奇心旺盛な女の子である。勉強もそこそこ出来るが、彼女が一番得意なのは運動。武器の八角棒を敵中に叩き込み、それを支柱にして対魔殺法を取り込んだ攻撃を繰り出す。何かに興味を抱くとそのことしか考えられず周りが見えなくなる性格で、本人もそれを自覚し、補うだけの実力をつけようと日々努力している。最近ではラジオの「はがき職人」に興味を持ち嵌っていて、他にも何か面白そうなことはないかと好奇心の赴くままに面白そうなことを探している。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin from Gosha Academy, gradually making a name for herself as a master of the Stone Concealment technique. She's a bright and cheerful girl who gets along with everyone, and while she's fairly good at her studies, her true talent lies in athletics. She wields an octagonal staff, using it to unleash powerful attacks that incorporate her Taimanin techniques. When she becomes interested in something, she tends to focus on it to the point where she becomes oblivious to her surroundings - a trait she's aware of and strives to balance with her daily training. Recently, she's become fascinated with the "Postcard Artisan" radio show and is always on the lookout for other interesting things to explore.

text.ja: 後輩対魔忍の藤嶺明華でーす。術は石遁、武器は八角棒！　よろしくお願いしま～す♪
text.en: Hi, I'm Fujimine Asuka, a junior Taimanin! My technique is Stone Concealment, and my weapon is the octagonal staff! Nice to meet you~

text.ja: 先輩って色々な人と知り合いなんですね～。怖そうな人もいるけど、ちょっとお話ししてみたいかも？
text.en: You seem to know a lot of people, Senior... some of them look pretty intimidating, but I think I'd like to get to know them a bit better.

text.ja: 前はラジオに投稿をよくしてたんですけど最近はやめちゃったんですよ。別にいやになったわけじゃないんですけどねー
text.en: I used to send in a lot of postcards to the radio show, but I haven't been doing it lately. It's not that I got bored with it or anything, though.

text.ja: むっ、なんですか『太った？』だなんて！　いくら先輩だからって、女の子にそんな事言っちゃダメですー
text.en: H-hey, what's with the "you've gained weight" comment? Just because you're my senior doesn't mean you can say something like that to a girl!

text.ja: 先輩、なんか面白いことないですか？　最近とくにハマっている物もないんでなにかしたいな～って思ってるんですよ
text.en: Hey, Senior, do you know anything fun I could do? I haven't really been into anything in particular lately, and I'm getting a little bored.

text.ja: スーツがキツそうですか？　うーん、確かに結構長く着てますけど、まだまだ全然着られますよ？
text.en: You think my suit looks a bit tight? Well, I have been wearing it for a while now, but it still fits me just fine.

text.ja: 私、一つの物にハマると周りが見えなくなるって言われるんですけど……面白かったら仕方ないですよね
text.en: People say that when I get into something, I tend to focus on it too much and lose sight of everything else... but if it's fun, I guess that's just how it is.

text.ja: 先輩の周りはなにか起きそうな感じがして、前から興味があったんですよー。現に今かなり面白いですし♪
text.en: I've always been interested in what's going on around you, Senior - it seems like something's always about to happen. And now that I'm here, I have to say, it's been pretty exciting so far.

text.ja: ひゃんっ！？　せ、先輩の視線を感じちゃいます～……んぅ、ふぅ、な、なんか身体が火照って……♪
text.en: H-Hey, I can feel your eyes on me, Senior... *giggle*... my body's getting all warm and fuzzy inside...

text.ja: んちゅるっ、ぢゅるるぅ～…ぷぁっ♪　先輩の味、段々美味しく感じてきちゃった♪　ハマっちゃうかも♪
text.en: Mmm, Senior's taste is getting more and more delicious... I think I might just get hooked on it.

text.ja: あっ、そ、そんな、お仕置きだなんてぇ……そ、想像しただけでエッチな気持ちになって濡れてきちゃいますよ～……♪
text.en: A-ah, no, not a punishment, Senior... just thinking about it is making me feel all naughty and wet...
